title: jasione humilis var. montana
intro: Jasione humilis var. montana, commonly known as Mountain Bluebells, is a species of flowering plant in the bellflower family, characterized by its small, bell-shaped flowers in shades of blue and white. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory conditions, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Bluebells include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antiseptic effects, which can help soothe respiratory tract irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Jasione humilis var. montana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
